about: The airport is in Irkutsk at 13 Shiryamova St, operator JSC Irkutsk International Airport. Direct flights connect it with 50 Russian cities; the international network includes 11 destinations. Passenger traffic exceeds 3.8 million people.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: Terminal 1 serves international flights. Terminal 2: domestic departures. Terminal 3: domestic arrivals.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Terminal 2 has a business lounge, a premium comfort lounge and VIP-1, VIP-2, VIP-3 lounges. The business lounge and premium comfort lounge are open 2 hours before departure if places are available, 4,250 ₽ per passenger. In terminal 1 the premium comfort lounge opens 3 hours before departure, 4,473 ₽. Dragon Pass cards are not accepted.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: In the domestic terminal on Level 1, payment in cash or by card. The base rate is 610 ₽ per item per day for baggage with a declared value of up to 2,000 ₽. A value must be declared; above 2,000 ₽, a surcharge of 100 ₽ applies for each further 1,000 ₽ of declared value. Baggage larger than 40×40×50 cm is charged by the number of spaces it occupies. In the international terminal, left luggage is on Level 2 and operates only during delays to international flights. Phone +7 (3952) 266-194.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Airport hotel Vozdushnaya Gavan, 6 Shiryamova St, 100 metres from the airport. 145 rooms, round-the-clock check-in, short stays. The domestic terminal has a direct-line phone to the hotel.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child rooms in the domestic terminal (Level 1, VIP area) and the international terminal (Level 2), open round the clock, free of charge. Children under 7: up to 3–4 hours before departure, 1 hour after arrival. One adult with the child. Apply at the information desk.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The first 10 minutes are free. 11–20 minutes 100 ₽, 21–30 minutes 200 ₽, 31–40 minutes 250 ₽, 41–50 minutes 300 ₽, 51–60 minutes 350 ₽. From 1 h 01 min to 2 h 40 min, the rate rises from 400 to 850 ₽ in steps of 50 ₽ for each 10 minutes; from 2 h 41 min to 24 hours 1,200 ₽, each following 24-hour period 1,200 ₽. Each terminal has its own car park. Drop-off and pick-up zone: 10 minutes free, longer stays incur a penalty of 2,000 ₽ per hour.
